name: Wild Sheep Foundation Grant-in-Aid
summary: Grants for projects that benefit wild sheep and their habitat, with current priority on active habitat management such as prescribed fire, vegetation treatment and water development. Proposals from or coordinated with the foundation's chapters and affiliates rank highest.
reporting: Grantees send written updates, progress and completion reports and photos or videos as set in the grant agreement.

deadline.quote: up to the submission deadline of 11:59 PM MDT July 31, 2026.

applicant_types.quote: Non-C&A applicants (e.g., agencies, universities, consultants, individuals, organizations, etc.) should coordinate closely with their local C&As, if applicable.

access.quote: Applications for the WSF FY 2026-27 GIA cycle will be accepted online only.

window.quote: up to the submission deadline of 11:59 PM MDT July 31, 2026.

co_finance_required.quote: Matching dollars or in-kind labor are not required but are considered favorably during proposal review and evaluation.

reporting.quote: Written updates, progress/completion reports, photos/videos, and other items as specified in the WSF Grant Agreement.
